source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_SEC_ACCOUNTLINK WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
STG.[ACCTKEY]
,convert(numeric(19,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[CLTCODE],' ',''),''),0)) as CLTCODE
,[LINKCODE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[SEC_ACCOUNTLINK_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_SEC_ACCOUNTLINK] STG ON DELTA.ACCTKEY = STG.ACCTKEY AND DELTA.CLTCODE = STG.CLTCODE
Where H = 'D'

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_SEC_PORTFOLIO WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
CUSTCODE
,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
,[SECURITY]
,convert(numeric(4,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([MSYEAR],' ',''),''),0)) as MSYEAR
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ENDSHARES],' ',''),''),0)) as ENDSHARES
,convert(numeric(18,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ENDVALUE],' ',''),''),0)) as ENDVALUE
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[ID],' ',''),''),0)) as ID
,convert(date, [REFDATE]) as REFDATE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,0 as EXECPRICE
,0 as SELLVALUE
,0 as GAINLOSS
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[SEC_PORTFOLIO_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_SEC_PORTFOLIO] STG ON DELTA.ID = STG.ID 
where H = 'D'
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_SEC_LEDGER WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT 
    CUSTCODE
    ,LAST6_ACCT_NUM
    ,REFCODE
    ,convert(date,REFDATE) AS REFDATE
    ,CURRCODE
    ,convert(numeric(18,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(CURRAMT,' ',''),''),0)) AS CURRAMT
    ,1 as isActive
    ,1 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(date,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM d360.STG_SEC_LEDGER
WHERE H = 'D'
